g.text: Local runs: October 25, 2026, Ollaya 0.17.0, CUDA, one request/model at a time; warm-up/loading excluded.
RTX 2060 6 GB was chosen deliberately as an older, more accessible hardware setup.
Hosted measurements retain their original dates, providers and loads. Latency is route-specific, not controlled hardware speed.
Local operating cost is unmeasured. *Free access is not a production tariff; + ? means missing hosted charges.
